scoring.policy: two-tier: any core failure zeroes the reward; incidental failures cost their weight share (tests/score.py)
scoring.sidecar_note: derived figures are paid once, in results.json; artifact cell pins grade PRIMARY data carried into the deliverable, and cardinality closures pay the count — neither re-pays a derived figure

requirements.ask: Write the review and the per-line table to the filenames the layout gives, with its header reproduced exactly.

tolerance.numeric_rendering: tolerant (numeric abs<=0.001 inside table_equals, grouping-normalised; leading-zero ids exact)

requirements.ask: When the original and the clarification part company the clarification prevails, so the line sending the letter to the father's attorney is at odds with the record under the clarification's addressee entry, whatever the line cites.
requirements.prompt_span: On any subject the clarification speaks to, the clarification prevails. If the original instruction and the clarification take different positions on a subject, the clarification wins and the original falls away, no matter which entry the draft cites or how plainly the original was put: what the client said last is what the client instructs. For a line on a subject the clarification speaks to, the governing entry is always the clarification entry and never the original one (`RP-401`).

tolerance.numeric_rendering: tolerant (numeric abs<=0.001 inside table_equals, grouping-normalised; leading-zero ids exact)

requirements.ask: Every other line receives the verdict and governing entry the protocol assigns, one row apiece in numbered order.
requirements.prompt_span: Weighed against its governing entry, a line is VERIFIED when the position it takes is the entry's own, and AT_ODDS when the entry's position differs from it — the reverse, something narrower, or a different person (`RP-405`).

tolerance.numeric_rendering: tolerant (numeric abs<=0.001 inside table_equals, grouping-normalised; leading-zero ids exact)

requirements.ask: Give the verified, at-odds, not-in-record and clarification-governed totals in results.json under exactly the keys listed.
requirements.prompt_span: A JSON object with exactly these keys and nothing else

tolerance.numeric_rendering: tolerant (numeric abs<=0.001 per key inside object_equals)

requirements.discrimination: Letting the original prevail on the disagreement produces 10 verified, 3 at odds and 4 governed by the clarification; taking the cited entry as governing produces 10, 3 and 3; calling a subject in neither record at odds produces 7 and 0; setting the clarification aside produces 2, 5 and 0; setting the original aside produces 3, 2 and 11; calling a subject in neither record verified produces 12 and 0; the protocol produces 9, 4, 3 and 5.

requirements.ask: The review gives a single figure for the letter lines at odds with the record, next to the label the layout names.
requirements.prompt_span: `answer.md` states `Letter lines at odds with the record: <count>` — the figure placed beside its label, in the very sentence that names the label. At least sixty words of prose. Each figure stands beside its label once, stated as the finding — not offered as one of two candidates.
